name: RC-B10-0471/2025 – After § 23 – Am 12
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
part_text: 23a. Stresses furthermore that the EU’s development cooperation must be conditional on good governance and effective cooperation on tackling migration and strengthening border control; urges the Commission and the Member States to conclude binding partnership agreements tackling migration with African countries, focused on both the reduction of illegal migration and on facilitating the return of illegal migrants; stresses that there is no need for additional legal pathways for migration to the EU;
